items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I can remember Slide, myself, [and] Gene Fowlkes hearing you [in Indianapolis]

ctx.x: Yeah. It was fun to play with Illinois Jacquet's band.
I can remember Slide, myself, [and] Gene Fowlkes hearing you [in Indianapolis] either at the Sunset Terrace or the Cotton Club with that band. Somebody also taped it illegally.
